independent_findings.finding: The original contains ten substantive units: sections 1(a)-(c), 2(a)-(d), 3(a)-(b), and 4. The section 2 lead-in joins its four duties; a standalone lead-in is not an additional substantive command. The full inventory must include the predecessor abolition/supersession in section 4.

No sunset or actual-report termination trigger appears in the full original extract. Section 2(d) requires an annual consolidated report; it does not terminate the Council or its duties when a report is due or submitted.

EO 11376 substitutes the entire original section 1(b). The held extract supplies October 17, 1967 and no deferred effective clause. Subject to required image/identity confirmation (heading OCR reads T1376; source confidence medium), the original membership wording cannot be assigned a first end in 1982. Revised membership authority continues to require distinct treatment.

EO 12106 section 1-103 revises section 1(b) again. Section 1-106 expressly makes the order effective January 1, 1979. December 28, 1978 is its signing date, not the effective amendment date. The OLRC reprint lead gives December 26; that discrepancy is not used as an effective date.

The full EO 12107 extract contains general OPM/CSC substitutions in section 2-101 and a January 1, 1979 general effective date in section 2-404. The extracted enumerated list does not visibly contain 11022; an OFR catalog amendment lead alone cannot establish a separate target-specific change. Any covered CSC references would already need reconciliation with the simultaneous complete membership revision in EO 12106. The original 1962 membership text had already been replaced in 1967.

EO 12379 section 12 expressly revokes EO 11022 as amended. The full actor extract ends without a deferred effective date, exception, or savings clause for this target. Its August 17, 1982 date supports formal revocation. Its preamble describes inactive or unnecessary committees and does not itself establish when the Council became inactive. This date is not automatically every clause first_end.

Section 4 immediately abolishes the council established by the March 7, 1959 letter and supersedes that letter. This completed legal change is materially different from ongoing Council operations. Do not label completion an exact first cessation without an applicable approved analytic basis, or assign 1982 to avoid the issue. Preserve a gap if its proper first_end treatment cannot be justified.

No Council-specific savings or revival clause appears in the original, EO 11376, EO 12106 or EO 12379 extracts. EO 12107 section 2-202 preserves personnel actions under revoked orders and does not by its own language establish a continuing President’s Council on Aging. The section 4 predecessor change and any accrued/transferred effects still require explicit analysis before a none_after_bounded_search assessment.

All five cited official source extracts have matching official-fixity rows for their four underlying issue PDFs. The expected PDF cache files are absent, and the repository file inventory yielded no matching issue/hash/name PDFs. Thus no original_pages_confirmed, authenticated transcription, or image verification finding is warranted.
